integrity: The proof handles \(1\), primes, odd squarefree composites, and even squarefree composites separately. The key exclusion is the exact fact that a number divisible by \(4\) with exactly four divisors must equal \(8\). The finite verifier is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only squarefree integers. It does not classify nonsquarefree members, resolve the possible prime-cube branch for \(\sigma(n)+\varphi(n)\), or prove infinitude of Sophie Germain primes.
title: Squarefree structure of \(\tau(\sigma(n)+\varphi(n))=4\)
